Adani Airports Secures $300 Million Funding

Adani Airport Holdings (AAHL) has raised $300 million (approximately ₹2,790 crore) in equity funding from 360 ONE Asset. This latest funding brings AAHL's total external equity funding to $1.35 billion (approximately ₹12,615 crore). The capital infusion is intended to support airport upgrades, city-side developments, and the expansion of non-aeronautical revenues. AAHL operates eight airports and aims to achieve an annual passenger capacity of 200 million. Following these transactions, investors will collectively hold about 7.01% of AAHL, which was valued at $18 billion for this funding round.
